items.text:
Ratification by the Board of Education of the President of the Board’s appointment of each individual named herein, to the Measure G Parcel Tax Independent Citizens’ Oversight Committee for term stated:

PERSON	TERM NUMBER/TERM DATE	
Harold Lowe 	1st Term/October 15, 2020 through January 31, 2021	
Pat Toney 	1st Term/October 15, 2019 through January 31, 2022	
Angalida Simon	1st Term/ October 15, 2019 through January 31, 2022	
Stephanie Hawke	1st Term/February 1, 2021 through January 31, 2023

attachments.name: 20-1809 General Services Agreement - Non-Competitively Bid - Elite Security Services - The Center Project - Division of Facilities Planning and Management

items.group: Deputy Chief, Facilities Planning and Management

history.action: Adopted on the General Consent Report
history.motion: A motion was made by Director Harris, seconded by Vice President Gonzales, to Approve the General Consent Report for Measures B and J General Obligation Bonds. The motion carried by the following vote

items.presenter: Deputy Chief, Facilities Planning and Management
items.text:
Approval by the Board of Education of General Services Agreement - Non Competitively Bid - between the District and Elite Security Services, Oakland, CA, for the latter to provide continued private patrol security services at the Center for protection from vandalism and for safety reasons for a fixed fee of $49,572.00 plus a $5,000.00 not-to-exceed contingency, for a total not to exceed $54,572.00, as the selected consultant, with work scheduled to commence on August 1, 2020, and scheduled to last until December 31, 2020.
.

items.text: Approval by the Board of Education of Agreement Between Owner and Contractor - Competitively bid -  Between the District and Innovative Construction Company (“Contractor”), Oakland, CA, for the latter to provide Mechanical, Electrical, and Plumbing, Framing and Drywall Services, applied to newly installed ceilings, for the Madison Academy Expansion Project, in the amount of $70,000.00, which includes a contingency of $2,000.00, as the lowest responsive and responsible bidder, and rejecting all other bids if any, with work scheduled to commence on October 15,  2020, lasting Seventy-seven (77) Calendar days, and to end on December 31, 2020.
